title: Microsoft updates Windows 11 to make PCs with 8GB of RAM up to 20% more responsive and multitasking up to 40% faster in lab tests, utilizing memory compression (Lance Whitney/ZDNET)
title_en: Microsoft updates Windows 11 to make PCs with 8GB of RAM up to 20% more responsive and multitasking up to 40% faster in lab tests, utilizing memory compression (Lance Whitney/ZDNET)
author: ZDNET
content_snippet:
The latest updates to Windows 11 offer improvements in speed, performance, and memory management.

The more memory your Windows PC has, the faster it should perform, especially when juggling multiple apps, files, and other data. My laptop has 32GB of RAM, while my desktop has a hefty 64GB, and both are absolutely zippy. Does that mean computers with only 8GB of memory, or even less, are also-rans? Nope, not according to Microsoft.

Also: How much RAM does your PC really need?

In a new blog post
summary_en: Microsoft recently announced updates to Windows 11, focusing on improved memory compression and reduced app memory footprints to boost performance on entry-level hardware. The update aims to mitigate performance bottlenecks for PCs with only 8GB of RAM, ensuring smoother multitasking and responsiveness.
title_zh: 微软优化Win11内存管理，8GB内存机型性能大增
summary_zh: 微软通过最新更新强化内存压缩算法，使8GB内存的Windows 11电脑响应速度提升20%，多任务处理效率提升40%

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 微软近期在官方博客发布更新，通过改进内存压缩策略和应用内存占用控制，显著提升了低配PC的表现。此举旨在解决入门级设备在多任务处理时的卡顿痛点，确保仅配备8GB内存的设备也能获得更流畅的系统响应体验。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Microsoft recently announced updates to Windows 11, focusing on improved memory compression and reduced app memory footprints to boost performance on entry-level hardware. The update aims to mitigate performance bottlenecks for PCs with only 8GB of RAM, ensuring smoother multitasking and responsiveness.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】微软在官方博客更新说明：通过内存压缩与管理优化，使8GB内存电脑响应速度提升20%，多任务处理快40%
【起因与机理】旨在提升低配硬件的系统效率，优化用户体验
【关键数据与实测】8GB内存设备响应提升20%，多任务快40%。
【各方立场与态度】通过优化算法让低配机型重获新生。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Microsoft (Official blog post): Optimized memory compression and management, boosting 8GB RAM performance by up to 20% in responsiveness and 40% in multitasking
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To improve system efficiency and user experience on entry-level hardware
[Key Metrics] 20% better responsiveness and 40% faster multitasking for 8GB RAM devices.
[Key Position & Outlook] Revitalizing low-spec hardware through software refinement.

title: Rockstar plans to let users pre-load GTA VI on November 10, ahead of its November 19 launch, and says the game requires up to 212GB "depending on your device" (Emma Roth/The Verge)
title_en: Rockstar plans to let users pre-load GTA VI on November 10, ahead of its November 19 launch, and says the game requires up to 212GB "depending on your device" (Emma Roth/The Verge)
author: The Verge
content_snippet:
Posts from this topic will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

Rockstar says to make sure you have ‘ample space’ on your device.

Posts from this author will be added to your daily email digest and your homepage feed.

You’re going to need a lot of extra storage space on your console if you’re planning to play Grand Theft Auto VI later this month. Rockstar Games confirmed on Tuesday that the pre-load file will require up to 212GB “depending on your device.”

title: Google is entirely disabling Search in schools that don’t want AI
title_en: Google is entirely disabling Search in schools that don’t want AI
author: The Verge AI
content_snippet:
Google is completely turning off Search in schools that reject its AI features, the company told The New York Times. The decision was also shared in a broader education-related update from Google on Tuesday, saying that access to Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Gemini in Classroom, and Google Search "will be entirely off" for K-12 student accounts unless "administrators explicitly turn them on."

Administrators will not be given the option to toggle Gemini-powered features off without disabling Search,
summary_en: Google has issued a mandate to K-12 schools: if administrators opt to disable AI features like Gemini and Notebook, access to Google Search will also be entirely deactivated. Google justifies this by stating Search and AI are deeply integrated, leaving schools with an ultimatum: embrace the AI ecosystem or lose the search engine.
title_zh: 谷歌强推AI：禁用AI就没搜索服务
summary_zh: 谷歌宣布K-12学校若拒绝启用Gemini等AI服务，系统将同步关闭搜索引擎入口，引发教育界争议

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 谷歌向K-12学校明确政策，若校方拒绝启用Gemini、Notebook等AI工具，则必须同时停用Google搜索。谷歌解释称因搜索功能已与AI深度集成，无法提供“去AI化”的独立搜索版本，此举直接强制教育机构在AI化和完全断网中二选一。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Google has issued a mandate to K-12 schools: if administrators opt to disable AI features like Gemini and Notebook, access to Google Search will also be entirely deactivated. Google justifies this by stating Search and AI are deeply integrated, leaving schools with an ultimatum: embrace the AI ecosystem or lose the search engine.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】谷歌在教育更新声明：若学校禁用AI功能，搜索服务将同步关闭，不可解绑
【起因与机理】AI已与搜索深度集成，谷歌试图借此强制在教育领域推行AI
【核心事实细节】谷歌向K-12学校明确政策，若校方拒绝启用Gemini、Notebook等AI工具，则必须同时停用Google搜索。
【各方立场与态度】谷歌用这种绑架式推广告诉学校：要么跟着我拥抱未来，要么回到石器时代查百科全书。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Google (Education update statement): Schools refusing AI features will lose access to Google Search, with no option to toggle separately
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Deep integration of AI in search as a lever to force AI adoption in schools
[Key Fact Detail] Disabling AI means losing Search.
[Key Position & Outlook] Mandatory AI adoption for schools.

title: AI agents take over at SETI's Allen Telescope Array, scanning for extraterrestrial intelligence
title_en: AI agents take over at SETI's Allen Telescope Array, scanning for extraterrestrial intelligence
author: THE DECODER
content_snippet:
The SETI Institute and Breakthrough Listen are now using AI agents at the Allen Telescope Array to control the telescope and analyze incoming radio signals. Tasks that used to take weeks can now wrap up in hours, and the team says the system detected a pulsar in the Crab Nebula in real time for the first time.

The article AI agents take over at SETI's Allen Telescope Array, scanning for extraterrestrial intelligence appeared first on The Decoder.
summary_en: The SETI Institute and Breakthrough Listen have deployed AI agents at the Allen Telescope Array to autonomously control the telescope and analyze incoming radio signals. This integration compresses weeks of data processing into hours, achieving the first-ever real-time detection of a pulsar in the Crab Nebula.
title_zh: SETI启用AI代理接管阵列
summary_zh: SETI研究所与Breakthrough Listen利用AI代理实时扫描外星信号，将数周任务缩短至数小时，并成功实时捕捉蟹状星云脉冲星

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: SETI研究所与Breakthrough Listen在艾伦望远镜阵列（ATA）部署了AI代理，用于全自动控制望远镜并实时分析入射无线电信号。此举旨在应对海量宇宙数据分析瓶颈，成功将原本需要数周的数据处理周期压缩至数小时，并在业内首次实现了对蟹状星云脉冲星的实时动态探测。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: The SETI Institute and Breakthrough Listen have deployed AI agents at the Allen Telescope Array to autonomously control the telescope and analyze incoming radio signals. This integration compresses weeks of data processing into hours, achieving the first-ever real-time detection of a pulsar in the Crab Nebula.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】SETI研究所与Breakthrough Listen：部署AI代理接管望远镜控制与信号分析，实时捕捉到蟹状星云脉冲星
【起因与机理】为了解决海量宇宙射电信号分析的效率瓶颈，加速外星智能搜寻
【核心事实细节】SETI研究所与Breakthrough Listen在艾伦望远镜阵列部署AI系统。
【各方立场与态度】为海量射电天文数据分析提供全新的自动化技术路径。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] SETI Institute and Breakthrough Listen (Allen Telescope Array): Deployed AI agents to control telescopes and analyze signals, achieving real-time pulsar detection
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To overcome cosmic data processing bottlenecks and accelerate the search for extraterrestrial intelligence
[Key Technical Spec] SETI and Breakthrough Listen deploy AI at telescope array.
[Key Position & Outlook] Provides a novel automated path for analyzing massive radio astronomy data.

title: UEFI bootkit infected fully patched Windows machines. Is Microsoft to blame?
title_en: UEFI bootkit infected fully patched Windows machines. Is Microsoft to blame?
author: Ars Technica
content_snippet:
In 2023, malware tracked as BlackLotus became the first publicly documented in-the-wild UEFI bootkit capable of bypassing Secure Boot on fully updated Windows 11 systems. With the industry-wide chain-of-trust mechanism subverted, the malware was able to run malicious code before Windows was fully loaded and many security defenses were operational.

Microsoft had already patched the vulnerability that BlackLotus exploited in 2022. In 2023 and 2024, Microsoft issued additional updates. The first a
summary_en: Fully patched modern Windows 11 systems have been compromised by new UEFI bootkits like BlackX, successfully bypassing the Secure Boot mechanism. Despite multiple rounds of certificate revocations and patches issued by Microsoft since 2022, attackers exploited underlying firmware vulnerabilities to execute malicious code before the operating system loaded.
title_zh: 完全打补丁Win系统遭Bootkit感染
summary_zh: 黑客利用新型BlackX等UEFI启动套件，成功绕过已安装所有官方安全补丁的Windows 11安全启动机制

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 在完全打过微软安全补丁的现代Windows 11系统上，近期曝出新型BlackX等恶意UEFI启动套件（Bootkit），成功绕过了被称为行业最后防线的安全启动（Secure Boot）机制。尽管微软自2022年起针对BlackLotus漏洞发布了多轮证书吊销和修补更新，但攻击者依然利用底层固件机制的固有漏洞，在操作系统加载前抢先植入并运行了恶意代码。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Fully patched modern Windows 11 systems have been compromised by new UEFI bootkits like BlackX, successfully bypassing the Secure Boot mechanism. Despite multiple rounds of certificate revocations and patches issued by Microsoft since 2022, attackers exploited underlying firmware vulnerabilities to execute malicious code before the operating system loaded.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】安全研究人员与受感染机构在企业及个人全更新Windows 11系统环境：黑客利用新型BlackX等UEFI引导套件，成功攻破已安装微软所有安全补丁的系统
【起因与机理】底层UEFI固件启动信任链遭到攻破，操作系统启动前的安全防线存在固有漏洞
【核心事实细节】完全打满安全补丁的Windows 11系统遭遇UEFI启动套件感染。
【各方立场与态度】暴露出计算机底层固件在操作系统加载前存在的安全隐患。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Security researchers and infected organizations: Hackers infected fully patched systems using new UEFI bootkits like BlackX, bypassing defenses
[Root Cause & Mechanism] The underlying UEFI firmware trust chain was subverted, leaving pre-OS defenses inherently vulnerable
[Key Fact Detail] Fully patched Windows 11 systems infected by UEFI bootkits.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Exposes deep-seated security risks in firmware before OS initialization.

title: Binance says North Korean hackers stole $6.3B through a months-long scheme with fake LinkedIn job interviews and an ad campaign to deliver malicious software (Jeff John Roberts/Fortune)
title_en: Binance says North Korean hackers stole $6.3B through a months-long scheme with fake LinkedIn job interviews and an ad campaign to deliver malicious software (Jeff John Roberts/Fortune)
author: Fortune
content_snippet:
Binance on Tuesday disclosed that North Korean hackers used a mix of social engineering and malicious software to pull off last week’s $6.3 billion heist, the biggest in crypto history. Speaking to reporters, company executives revealed that the hackers targeted a Binance engineer on LinkedIn and arranged a series of fake job interviews in order to persuade the employee to download an “assignment” that let them invade the company’s systems.

In a related report, Binance explained that: “Software
summary_en: Binance disclosed that North Korean hackers executed the largest crypto heist in history, stealing $6.3 billion through a months-long social engineering campaign. The hackers posed as project directors on LinkedIn to trick engineers into downloading malicious 'assignments' and contaminated software packages like Homebrew.

summary_zh: 币安披露朝鲜黑客通过领英虚假招聘及恶意广告组合拳，实施加密史上最大63亿美元盗窃案

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】币安高管与朝鲜黑客组织在LinkedIn招聘平台及币安内部系统环境：通过伪装高管进行虚假面试和篡改软件包，诱导工程师下载恶意代码完成63亿美元惊天盗窃

[Root Cause & Mechanism] Exploiting human psychology and standard job-seeking routines to bypass heavy technical firewalls
[Key Metrics] Compromised internal environments via malicious assignments and software, stealing $6.3B.

title: ChatGPT Consumer Product Lead Adam Fry says ChatGPT has hit 1.2B WAUs, adding 200M over the past two months, and its search volume is now ~20% of Google's (Alex Kantrowitz/Big Technology)
title_en: ChatGPT Consumer Product Lead Adam Fry says ChatGPT has hit 1.2B WAUs, adding 200M over the past two months, and its search volume is now ~20% of Google's (Alex Kantrowitz/Big Technology)
author: Big Technology
content_snippet:
OpenAI says ChatGPT growth is accelerating.

The company added 200 million users over just the past two months, jumping from 1 billion to 1.2 billion weekly active users in 60 days. Its search volume, it says, is approximately 20% of Google’s. Its users create 1.5 billion images with it per week. And its voice mode, between dictation and speaking with ChatGPT, now has 250 million combined weekly active users.

ChatGPT consumer product lead Adam Fry told me this during a brief fireside chat at an

title: Google plans to make it easier to restrict its AI tools for students in early 2027, but says schools that block AI entirely will lose student access to Search (New York Times)
title_en: Google plans to make it easier to restrict its AI tools for students in early 2027, but says schools that block AI entirely will lose student access to Search (New York Times)
author: New York Times
content_snippet: Google is making it easier to restrict its A.I. tools for students. But schools that block A.I. entirely will lose student access to Google's search engine.
summary_en: Google plans to introduce tools in early 2027 making it easier for schools to restrict AI use among students. title: Here's Why You Shouldn't Use AI to Vote
title_en: Here's Why You Shouldn't Use AI to Vote
author: Wired AI
content_snippet:
Around 50 percent of recently surveyed US adults have at one time used an AI chatbot, and 8 percent say they have used these tools ahead of the midterms to find information on candidates and policies, according to Pew Research.

But a lot of information from these chatbots is out of date and has been hallucinated or sourced from partisan websites.

Even supposedly non-partisan chatbots like OpenAI’s ChatGPT, Anthropic’s Claude, and Google’s Gemini have been found wanting when it comes to questio
summary_en: Recent studies by Pew Research and Forum AI reveal that nearly 40 percent of election-related answers provided by mainstream chatbots like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini contain factual errors, outdated info, or hallucinations. Despite growing public reliance on AI for midterm voting info, researchers warn against using these unreliable tools due to systemic data pollution and LLM hallucination issues.

title: The Download: controlling AI agents and “Super Intelligence” loyalty tests
title_en: The Download: controlling AI agents and “Super Intelligence” loyalty tests
author: MIT Tech Review
content_snippet:
A new approach known as “reverse game theory” aims to control powerful AI models by designing systems that incentivize them to stick to the rules.

While game theory predicts how rational actors behave under particular rules, reverse game theory designs rules to elicit the behavior we want. Think of splitting a cake: if one person cuts it and the other gets first choice, the cutter has an incentive to make the portions equal.

Researchers believe the approach could align AI more closely with our
summary_en: Researchers are attempting to tame future AI using 'reverse game theory,' designing rules where AI is incentivized to follow instructions rather than rebel. This approach aims to address superintelligence risks by structurally aligning AI behaviors with human interests through strategic incentive design.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 华为近期告知客户，需自行解决其AI芯片所需的高性能内存采购问题，此举变相将供应链采购压力推向了灰色黑市。由于美国出口禁令限制，走私者利用将HBM与低端处理器捆绑、经由香港转运并在当地拆解的漏洞，导致HBM3E内存价格在短短一年内飙升至每块约4000美元。
ai_analysis.briefing_en: Huawei is telling customers to independently source high-performance memory for its AI chips, effectively shifting procurement to the black market. Due to U.S. export controls, smugglers are exploiting loopholes by bundling HBM with low-end processors via Hong Kong and splitting them on-site, causing HBM3E prices to skyrocket to $4,000 per unit.

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】华为与其AI芯片客户、走私贩在全球芯片供应链与黑市（主要通过香港中转）：华为要求客户自行采购AI芯片内存，走私商通过捆绑低端芯片漏洞倒卖HBM3E，单价飙升至4000美元

【关键数据与实测】HBM3E内存因黑市炒作，价格在一年内暴涨至4000美元/块。
【各方立场与态度】走私者通过“捆绑低端芯片、香港中转、现场拆解”规避制裁。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Huawei, its AI chip customers, and black-market smugglers: Huawei tells clients to source their own memory; smugglers exploit bundling loopholes to push HBM3E prices to $4,000
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Strict U.S. export controls severed official supply lines, driving desperate buyers into the underground market
[Key Metrics] HBM3E black market prices surge to $4,000 per unit within a year.
[Key Position & Outlook] Smugglers bypass sanctions via bundling, Hong Kong shipping, and on-site splitting.

title: Bug hunters can now earn up to $172,000 from OpenAI as company ramps up security

Exceptional findings can net up to $100,000, and with quality, loyalty, and campaign bonuses, the total can reach roughly $172,000.

summary_en: OpenAI has boosted its maximum bug bounty reward to $172,000, introducing a five-tier loyalty program and time-limited campaigns to bolster the security of core products like ChatGPT. title_en: The Download: the agentic web arrives and the drive for safer roads
author: MIT Tech Review
summary_en:
In 2001, a decade after inventing the World Wide Web, Tim Berners-Lee articulated a new vision: an internet navigated by autonomous software agents that address our every need, without requiring us to muck about with browsers and search engines ourselves.
